title: Campaign asset-price table: E7 USD numbers must be reproducible
description: USD quantification is only reproducible if the price basis is recorded, not improvised mid-run (run 1: the operator web-searched an ETH price while minting E7). Every price row carries value + source + as_of + the actor who set it. E7 impact numbers cite a price_id; the report renders the basis next to every USD figure.

source.description: where the number came from (coinmetrics, operator, exchange page ...) — never 'web search mid-run'
